faction.highlands-town.highlands.descrip: The Highlands (Mountain Dwarves) are primarily located in the Vori Mountains and consist of dwarves who remained in their homeland. Unlike some dwarves who migrated to warmer regions, the Mountain Dwarves are more martial and skilled in using fire. Sharing the same origins as the dwarves and elves who migrated to Avlee, the Kingdom of Vori is also composed of dwarves and snow elves.
faction.highlands-town.highlands.name: Highlands
hero.highlands-town.11bulwarkSylphine.bi: Sylphine is the leader of the legendary snow elf witches and a highly learned archmage. During the war against the ice demons, she and her apprentices greatly aided the Vori elves. They steadfastly guarded every inch of their homeland.
hero.highlands-town.11bulwarkSylphine.sp: Increases the Speed and Cast of allied Snow Witches and Ice Sorceresses by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.highlands-town.a_daive.biography: Daive used to be the loyal advocate for Gelu the elf king. He had been a dwarf leader in Avlee for many years. However, since he learned the madness of Gelu from his friend Ufretin, the leader did not decide to fight for him anymore. He started to back home and fight for his own people.
hero.highlands-town.a_daive.name: Daive
hero.highlands-town.a_daive.specialty.de: Increases Speed of any Defenders and Mountain Guards by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level.
hero.highlands-town.b_richmond.biography: Richmond supposes he would be the hermit in the snow mountain. Only cold weather will make him comfortable. Thus he tamed many falcons as his companions. However, sometimes he will be found in a little pub, maybe the lonely dwarf is also eager to a warm atmosphere.
hero.highlands-town.b_richmond.name: Richmond
hero.highlands-town.b_richmond.specialty: Increases Speed of any Falcons and Blizzard Falcons by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.highlands-town.c_harrigan.biography: As the leader of 'Hunter Alliance', Harrigan often goes hunting with his group members, and gives out his harvests to the poor. In his view, hunting is not for food, but for improving his skills. He believes his talent can be used into battlefields.
hero.highlands-town.c_harrigan.name: Harrigan
hero.highlands-town.c_harrigan.specialty: Increases Speed of any Javeliners and Harpooners by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.highlands-town.d_austin.biography: Austin is interested in the research of ballista. He likes learning the mechnical principles and use it into practice. That makes him skilled in artillery.
hero.highlands-town.d_austin.name: Austin
hero.highlands-town.d_austin.specialty.d: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ballista by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.highlands-town.e_princehogg.biograp: Prince Hogg claims that he will be the true (and only) successor of the throne. Although his brother Rudolf surpasses him a lot in many aspects, he still believes only him can be the real dwarf king in the future. After he created the loyal troops for himself, it is the time to realize his ambition!
hero.highlands-town.e_princehogg.name: Prince Hogg
hero.highlands-town.e_princehogg.special: Increases kingdom's gold production by 350 per day.
hero.highlands-town.f_gestalt.biography: All individuals suppose Gestalt is the insane for battle. As a mercenary, even the lords in Niggon know the madness of him. He has no opinion of justice, only battle can bring fun for him.
hero.highlands-town.f_gestalt.name: Gestalt
Increases Speed of any Brutes and Berserks by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.highlands-town.g_aaron.biography: Aaron claims he is a philosopher, but many people do not recognize him. Because this dwarf never relates himself with philosophy. However, he still suppose that no one found his 'true' wisdom.
hero.highlands-town.g_aaron.name: Aaron
hero.highlands-town.g_aaron.specialty.de: Receives a 10% per level bonus to Learning skill percentage.
hero.highlands-town.h_craighill.biograph: Craig Hill used to be a fighter in Krewlod. After experienced a long period sojourn, he became increasingly like a barbarian. Although he has already backed home, he cannot find the original feeling as a dwarf.
hero.highlands-town.h_craighill.name: Craig Hill
hero.highlands-town.h_craighill.specialt: Increases Speed of any Gladiators and Flame Gladiators by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.highlands-town.i_aidan.biography: Aidan fell in love with a human in the past, but she was not accepted to marry him in her hometown. Thus, she eloped with her love. However, when she learned they are also not accepted by human community, she had to give up and never believe 'love' any longer.
hero.highlands-town.i_aidan.name: Aidan
hero.highlands-town.i_aidan.specialty.de: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Sorcery skill percentage.
hero.highlands-town.j_barbara.biography: Since her request for dancing was rejected in a party, Barbara started to know the inherent gap between human and dwarves. She desperated to integrate with human but finally she found it is impossible. Thus, she had to anchor her hope on magic, and then became a sorceress.
hero.highlands-town.j_barbara.name: Barbara
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill percentage.
hero.highlands-town.k_cynthia.biography: Cynthia believes that she should be a fairy, instead of a dwarf. Before she backed to her hometown, she had lived in Avlee with sprites for a long time. Everyone who know her suppose that she looks like a true fairy, except without a pair of wings.
hero.highlands-town.k_cynthia.name: Cynthia
Casts Ice Bolt with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.highlands-town.l_astride.biography: Astride (former name is Astra) was a sorceress in Enroth, she came to Vori simply because of the myterious covenant between sorceresses and dwarves. Although the covenant had became invalid recent years, she is still not willing to leave here. Maybe she is attracted by fire magic.
hero.highlands-town.l_astride.name: Astride
Casts Fire Ball with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.highlands-town.m_mildura.biography: As an assistant for Sanya the cleric, Mildura spent her early years in a monastery in Erathia. She found her behavior is totally different from other dwarves when she back home. However, she never give up to humanize the people in her hometown, by using the truth she had learned previously.
hero.highlands-town.m_mildura.name: Mildura
Increases kingdom's crystal production by 1 per day.
hero.highlands-town.n_renee.biography: Renee doesn't like the lifestyle of dwarves, but she has to choose Vori as her refuge. Someone indicated she is a betrayed necromancer. Almost everyone know the truth of her even though she never admits her history.
hero.highlands-town.n_renee.name: Renee
hero.highlands-town.n_renee.specialty.de: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Mysticism skill percentage.
hero.highlands-town.o_melisa.biography: Melisa claims that she was the only surviour of a catastrophe. She used to experience a deadly volcanic eruption in Kreegan when she was young. After that, she started to learn fire magic, and hope she can make the devastation once again, by using her own ability.
hero.highlands-town.o_melisa.name: Melisa
hero.highlands-town.o_melisa.specialty.d: Casts Fire Shield with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.highlands-town.p_leslie.biography: Leslie married a dwarf prince and then become the nobility in Vori. However, she never feels pride for that. She never condescends herself to others while meeting with civillians.
hero.highlands-town.p_leslie.name: Leslie
hero.highlands-town.p_leslie.specialty.d: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
heroClass.highlands-town.bwarlord.name: Warlord
skill.hota.bulwark.runes.description.bas:
{Basic Runes}

Basic Runes allow hero's units to accumulate up to 3 Rune Levels in combat. Each Rune Level gives bonuses to the creature stats:

{1}: +2 attack, {2}: +2 defence, {3}: +1 speed.

The bonuses of all achieved Rune Levels are cumulative. The unit gains +1 Rune Level when it attacks; +2 Rune Levels when it takes damage; +3 Rune Levels when it takes a defensive stance.

It can also raise a hero's rune spell level to the basic level.
